summary: Nothing has moved at Verity. The original driver — ramping new reps faster — is still a real problem but no longer a priority, because hiring was paused in August. Their enablement lead left in July and nobody picked the initiative up, so there is no internal champion. Tom would not give a date he did not believe in and asked to be revisited in January.
